shell.gateCaption: Mission Control opens once an agent has talked to Oxagen. That first frame is also the installer's smoke test, so there is one path, not two.
shell.registerCaption: Registration completes once the agent has talked to Oxagen. That first frame is also the installer's smoke test. Cancel at any time; nothing is kept until the frame arrives.

errors.slugInvalid: Use 2–40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
errors.slugReserved: That address is used by an Oxagen page. Pick another.
errors.workspaceNameRequired: Enter a name for the first workspace.
errors.workspaceSlugInvalid: Use 2–40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.workspaceSlugReserved: That address is used by an organization page. Pick another.
errors.slugTaken: That address belongs to another organization. Pick a different one.
errors.namespaceTaken: That namespace belongs to another organization. Pick a different 2–6 character namespace.
errors.agentSlugInvalid: Use 2–40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.failed: The organization could not be created. Nothing was saved; try again.

organization.title: Name your organization
organization.lead: The organization is the tenant: it owns its own graph database, its own encryption key, its billing account, and the namespace that appears in every agent key.
organization.name: Organization name
organization.slugHint: Mission Control lives at /{slug}. You can change the address later.
organization.namespaceHint: 2–6 characters and immutable. Every agent key starts with it, as in {example}.
organization.workspaceHint: A workspace is a governance partition: one main repo, one ontology, one steering set, its own agents, tool grants and budgets.
organization.creates: Creates the organization {name} and its first workspace.

name.title: Name the agent
name.lead: The key is reserved now and never changes. The agent itself exists only after its first frame reaches Oxagen.
name.workspaceHint: Its definition file lands in .oxagen/agents/ in the main repo.
name.harnessHint: Picks the installer on the next step. You can change it there.
name.tierHint: Routed through the model proxy; the tier is recorded on every frame.
name.note: Continue does not write anything. The agent's definition is proposed by the installer's smoke session once its first frame arrives.

wrap.lead: A wrapped agent routes through at least one gateway seam: the model proxy, the tool gateway, or both. The installer carries a single-use enrollment token for {key}, so nothing is copied or pasted.
wrap.claudeCode: The installer writes the hooks and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, installs the oxagend collector and the oxagen-hook binary, starts them at login, and enrolls this host with an Ed25519 device key.
wrap.codex: The same installer with the Codex profile. It writes ~/.codex/config.toml: MCP servers pointed at the tool gateway, OPENAI_BASE_URL at the model proxy, the notify hook to the collector, and the approval policy routed through Oxagen.
wrap.sdk: Five lines in your own process. oxagen.agent.wrap('{}') installs the proxy base URL, a frame emitter, the checkpoint gate before each turn, and the Oxagen MCP endpoint as the agent's tool server. Works with the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Claude Agent SDK, Stella and any custom loop.
wrap.tierNote: The enforcement tier is computed per run from what was actually routed, never from what the adapter can do on paper.
wrap.installerNotBacked: The signed one-click installer and its embedded token are not recorded yet. Enroll this host with the CLI instead.
wrap.credentialNote: Set it as OXAGEN_AGENT_TOKEN. The gateway mints short-lived run tokens from it at run start; revoking the credential ends every run token at the next call.
wrap.credentialNotBacked: Agent credentials for SDK agents are not issued from this screen yet.
wrap.alreadyInstalled: I have already installed it — continue
wrap.noDone: Nothing completes until a frame arrives.

run.gateLead: Mission Control opens the moment the first frame from {key} reaches Oxagen, and lands you on Fleet looking at your own run.
run.registerLead: Registration completes the moment the first frame from {key} reaches Oxagen, and lands you on Fleet looking at its run.
run.waitingHint: Start {harness} in any repository on {host}. The installer already ran a one-turn smoke session; if it is still in flight this flips on its own.
run.tierNote: The enforcement tier is computed from what was actually routed. Both seams answered, so this run is {tier}.
run.noDone: There is no Done button: the frame is the completion.
run.notBacked: Oxagen does not record the first frame from a newly wrapped agent yet, so this screen cannot wait for it. Your agent's runs appear on Fleet once they are recorded.
run.errorTitle: The collector cannot reach the model proxy
run.errorBody: The host {host} enrolled, but every request to the model proxy has been refused. A proxy that cannot be reached means an unwrapped agent, so this will not complete on telemetry alone.
run.errorHint: Check that outbound 443 to the proxy is allowed, then run oxagen agent status.

repo.readFrom: Read from the git remote of {directory}, the directory the installer ran in. Production branch {branch}.
repo.bindNote: One click installs the GitHub App on {repo}: repo binding, Context PRs, checks, merge handling and the code graph.
repo.skipNote: The workspace stays provisional for {days} days. Runs record and spend counts, but steering, context records and agent definitions stay off until a main repo is bound.
repo.boundNote: Steering, context records and agent definitions will live in {repo} under .oxagen/, published through Context PRs.
repo.notBacked: The repository the installer ran in is not reported yet. Bind a main repo from Ontology › Repositories after the first run.

states.scopeMissingBody: This step needs an organization and workspace. Name them first.
states.scopeNotFoundBody: It does not exist, or your account is not a member of it.
